dedupe_keys.name: pypsa spice national energy scenario builder

description: PyPSA-SPICE builds national and multinational energy-system scenarios on the PyPSA optimisation engine. Agora Energy contributors publish its model-builder source, documentation and workflow configuration. Users provide technology costs, demands, resource assumptions, network data and policy constraints for one or more countries. The workflow constructs a least-cost, multi-sector model and produces investments, dispatch and energy-flow results for the selected planning years and temporal resolution. Its geography follows the input countries, not a fixed packaged world model. The source code is free under GPL-2.0-or-later; documentation has a separate CC-BY-4.0 licence. A limitation is that a credible scenario still needs consistent, versioned input datasets and solver choices. The README asks prospective users to contact the developers for setup help, but the source and documentation are public. This platform supports electricity and heat transition studies. The catalogue's model-pypsa is the underlying general modelling engine, while this draft covers the scenario-building workflow. No scenario was executed.
